'''Markdown''' is the formatting language of posts on [[Melek.salon|melek.salon]]. You type plain text with a few marks, and the preview under the editor shows the formatted result. Part of [[Posting on MELEK]].

== Common formatting ==
* Heading: start a line with <code>#</code> (largest), <code>##</code> or <code>###</code>.
* Bold: <code>**bold**</code>. Italic: <code>*italic*</code>. Strikethrough: <code>~~struck~~</code>.
* Link: <code>[words people click](web address)</code>.
* Picture: <code>![description](picture address)</code>. See [[Images and Video in Posts]].
* List: start lines with <code>-</code> or <code>*</code>; numbered lists with <code>1.</code>, <code>2.</code>.
* Quote: start a line with <code>></code>.
* Horizontal line: a line with only <code>---</code>.
* Code: wrap a word in backticks, or put a block between lines of three backticks.
* Table: rows of cells separated by <code>|</code>, with a <code>|---|---|</code> line under the header row.

== Mentions and links to posts ==
* Write <code>@name</code> to mention an account. The name becomes a link to that profile, and the account is notified.
* Paste a melek.salon post address on its own line to link it.
* Write <code>#tag</code> to link a tag feed.

== HTML ==
A small set of HTML also works, such as <code><center></code>, <code><sub></code>, <code><sup></code> and <code><br></code>. Scripts, forms and styles are removed when the post is shown.

== Line breaks ==
Leave an empty line between paragraphs. A single line break inside a paragraph shows as a break in the preview; if it does not, end the line with two spaces.
